name: l3_name_sync_query
description: Query to get discount data for l3_name
attribute_value: {"query": "WITH discount_map AS (\\nSELECT * FROM UNNEST([{formatted_data}])\\n),\\n\\n\\n-- Split PG discounts into l2-only and l3 level\\ndiscount_l3 AS (\\nSELECT * except (discount), round(discount*100/5)*5/100 as discount FROM discount_map WHERE l3_name IS NOT NULL\\n),\\n\\n\\n-- Season mapping\\nseason_mapping AS (\\nSELECT DISTINCT a.fiscal_year_week, sm.season_code, sm.name AS season_name\\nFROM `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.fiscal_date_mapping` a\\nJOIN `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.season_master` sm\\nON a.date BETWEEN sm.season_start_date AND sm.season_end_date\\n),\\n\\n\\n-- Lifecycle level\\nlifecycle_level AS (\\nSELECT\\nstyle AS placeholder_style_id,\\narticle AS placeholder_choice_id,\\nl0_name,l1_name, l2_name,\\nl3_name as final_level,----level will change based on levels\\nb.channel,\\n1 AS launch,discount,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity) AS sales_units,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity * aur) AS sales,\\nSUM((aur - cost) * predicted_quantity) AS gross_margin,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity / 0.6) AS total_inv_units,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity / 0.6) AS receipt_units,\\nAVG(msrp) AS receipts_price_per_unit,\\nSUM((predicted_quantity / 0.6) * msrp) AS receipts,\\nSAFE_DIVIDE(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(predicted_quantity), COUNT(DISTINCT a.store_code)),\\nCOUNT(DISTINCT RIGHT(CAST(fiscal_year_week AS STRING), 2))) AS aps,\\n0.6 AS st,\\nAVG(aur) AS aur,\\nCOUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN predicted_quantity > 0 THEN fiscal_year_week END) AS avg_wk_cnt\\nFROM `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.iaf_assortsmart_article_store_level` a\\nLEFT JOIN `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.store_master` b\\nON a.store_code = b.store_code\\nGROUP BY style, article,l0_name, l1_name, l2_name, l3_name, b.channel,launch,discount\\n),\\n\\n\\n-- Season level\\nseason_level AS (\\nSELECT\\ns.season_code, s.season_name,\\nstyle AS placeholder_style_id,\\narticle AS placeholder_choice_id,\\nl0_name,l1_name, l2_name,\\nl3_name as final_level,------changes with levels\\nb.channel, 1 AS launch,\\ndiscount,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity) AS sales_units,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity * aur) AS sales,\\nSUM((aur - cost) * predicted_quantity) AS gross_margin,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity / 0.6) AS total_inv_units,\\nSUM(predicted_quantity / 0.6) AS receipt_units,\\nAVG(msrp) AS receipts_price_per_unit,\\nSUM((predicted_quantity / 0.6) * msrp) AS receipts,\\nSAFE_DIVIDE(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(predicted_quantity), COUNT(DISTINCT a.store_code)),\\nCOUNT(DISTINCT RIGHT(CAST(fiscal_year_week AS STRING), 2))) AS aps,\\n0.6 AS st,\\nAVG(aur) AS aur,\\nCOUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN predicted_quantity > 0 THEN fiscal_year_week END) AS avg_wk_cnt\\nFROM `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.iaf_assortsmart_article_store_level` a\\nLEFT JOIN `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.store_master` b\\nON a.store_code = b.store_code\\nJOIN season_mapping s USING (fiscal_year_week)\\nGROUP BY season_code, season_name,l0_name, l1_name, l2_name,l3_name, b.channel, style, article,discount\\n),\\n\\n\\n--Joins for l3-level PG discounts\\njoined_l3 AS (\\nSELECT\\nd.hierarchy_code,l.final_level,\\ns.season_code, s.season_name,\\nl.placeholder_choice_id, l.placeholder_style_id,\\nl.launch, l.channel,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.total_inv_units, 'lifecycle_reco', l.total_inv_units) AS total_inv_units,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.sales_units, 'lifecycle_reco', l.sales_units) AS sales_units,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.receipt_units, 'lifecycle_reco', l.receipt_units) AS receipt_units,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.receipts_price_per_unit, 'lifecycle_reco', l.receipts_price_per_unit) AS receipts_price_per_unit,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.aps, 'lifecycle_reco', l.aps) AS aps,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.sales, 'lifecycle_reco', l.sales) AS sales,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.receipts, 'lifecycle_reco', l.receipts) AS receipts,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.st, 'lifecycle_reco', l.st) AS st,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.avg_wk_cnt, 'lifecycle_reco', l.avg_wk_cnt) AS avg_wk_cnt,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.gross_margin, 'lifecycle_reco', l.gross_margin) AS gross_margin,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.aur, 'lifecycle_reco', l.aur) AS aur,\\n'{}' AS aic,\\n'{}' AS air\\nFROM lifecycle_level l\\nRIGHT JOIN season_level s\\nON s.l0_name =l.l0_name\\nAND s.l1_name = l.l1_name\\nAND s.l2_name = l.l2_name\\nAND s.final_level = l.final_level\\nAND s.channel = l.channel\\nAND s.placeholder_choice_id = l.placeholder_choice_id\\nAND s.placeholder_style_id = l.placeholder_style_id\\nJOIN discount_l3 d\\nON d.channel = l.channel\\nAND d.l0_name = l.l0_name\\nAND d.l1_name = l.l1_name\\nAND d.l2_name = l.l2_name\\nAND d.l3_name = l.final_level\\nAND d.discount = l.discount\\n),\\n\\n\\n-- Default 50% fallback for hierarchies not covered in PG\\nfallback AS (\\nSELECT\\nCONCAT(\\n  'l0_name_',REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(l.l0_name), r'\\s+', '_'),\\n  '_l1_name_', REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(l.l1_name), r'\\s+', '_'),\\n  '_l2_name_', REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(l.l2_name), r'\\s+', '_'),\\n  '_l3_name_', REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(l.final_level), r'\\s+', '_')\\n) AS hierarchy_code,\\nl.final_level AS final_level,\\ns.season_code, s.season_name,\\nl.placeholder_choice_id, l.placeholder_style_id,\\nl.launch, l.channel,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.total_inv_units, 'lifecycle_reco', l.total_inv_units) AS total_inv_units,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.sales_units, 'lifecycle_reco', l.sales_units) AS sales_units,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.receipt_units, 'lifecycle_reco', l.receipt_units) AS receipt_units,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.receipts_price_per_unit, 'lifecycle_reco', l.receipts_price_per_unit) AS receipts_price_per_unit,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.aps, 'lifecycle_reco', l.aps) AS aps,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.sales, 'lifecycle_reco', l.sales) AS sales,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.receipts, 'lifecycle_reco', l.receipts) AS receipts,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.st, 'lifecycle_reco', l.st) AS st,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.avg_wk_cnt, 'lifecycle_reco', l.avg_wk_cnt) AS avg_wk_cnt,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.gross_margin, 'lifecycle_reco', l.gross_margin) AS gross_margin,\\nJSON_OBJECT('season_reco', s.aur, 'lifecycle_reco', l.aur) AS aur,\\n'{}' AS aic,\\n'{}' AS air\\nFROM lifecycle_level l\\nRIGHT JOIN season_level s\\n   ON s.l0_name = l.l0_name\\n AND s.l1_name = l.l1_name\\n  AND s.l2_name = l.l2_name\\n  AND s.final_level = l.final_level\\n  AND s.channel = l.channel\\n  AND s.placeholder_choice_id = l.placeholder_choice_id\\n  AND s.placeholder_style_id = l.placeholder_style_id\\n  AND s.discount=l.discount\\n WHERE l.discount = 0.5\\n   AND NOT EXISTS (\\n     SELECT 1\\n     FROM discount_map d\\n     WHERE d.channel = l.channel\\nAND d.l0_name = l.l0_name\\n       AND d.l1_name = l.l1_name\\n       AND d.l2_name = l.l2_name\\n       AND d.l3_name = l.final_level\\n       AND d.season_code = CAST(s.season_code AS STRING)\\n   )\\n)\\n\\n\\n-- Final result\\nSELECT * FROM joined_l3\\nUNION ALL\\nSELECT * FROM fallback;"}

====================================================================================\\n\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.ty_receipts_new` (\\nl0_name STRING,\\nl1_name STRING,\\nl2_name STRING,\\nstore_type STRING,\\nsub_channel STRING,\\nfiscal_year INT64,\\nfiscal_month INT64,\\nfiscal_week INT64,\\nseason_code INT64,\\nseason_name STRING,\\n\\nty_rcpt_units FLOAT64,\\nty_rcpt_cost FLOAT64,\\nty_rcpt_msrp FLOAT64,\\nrcpt_msrp FLOAT64,\\ntarget_revenue FLOAT64,\\ntarget_cost FLOAT64,\\ntarget_units FLOAT64,\\nbop_units FLOAT64,\\n\\ncreated_at TIMESTAMP,\\nupdated_at TIMESTAMP,\\nis_updated BOOL\\n);\\n\\n-- ====================================================================================\\n-- 2) MERGE INTO Briscoes TY Receipts (Direct KPI Mapping)\\n-- ====================================================================================\\n\\nMERGE INTO `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.ty_receipts_new` AS tgt\\nUSING (\\nWITH season_first_week AS (\\nSELECT\\nsm.season_code,\\nMIN(fd.fiscal_year_week) AS first_fiscal_week\\nFROM `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.fiscal_date_mapping` fd\\nJOIN `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.season_master` sm\\nON fd.date BETWEEN sm.season_start_date AND sm.season_end_date\\nGROUP BY sm.season_code\\n),\\n\\nsrc_data AS (\\nSELECT\\nom.l0_name,\\nom.l1_name,\\nom.l2_name,\\nom.s1_name AS store_type,\\nom.s1_name AS sub_channel,\\n\\nfd.fiscal_year,\\nfd.fiscal_month,\\nfd.fiscal_week,\\nsm.season_code,\\nsm.name AS season_name,\\n\\nSUM(om.kpi12) AS ty_rcpt_units,\\n\\n-- Cost/margin fields\\nSUM(SAFE_DIVIDE(om.kpi13, NULLIF(om.kpi12, 0)) * om.kpi12) AS ty_rcpt_cost,\\nSUM(SAFE_DIVIDE(om.kpi43, NULLIF(om.kpi12, 0)) * om.kpi12) AS ty_rcpt_msrp,\\nSUM(om.kpi44 * om.kpi12) AS rcpt_msrp,\\n\\n-- Target performance\\nSUM(om.kpi1) AS target_revenue,\\nSUM(SAFE_DIVIDE(om.kpi4, NULLIF(om.kpi2, 0)) * om.kpi2) AS target_cost,\\nSUM(om.kpi2) AS target_units,\\n\\n-- BOP Units only for the first week of the season\\nSUM(\\nCASE WHEN fd.fiscal_year_week = sfw.first_fiscal_week THEN om.kpi9 ELSE 0 END\\n) AS bop_units\\n\\nFROM `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.op_master` om\\nJOIN `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.fiscal_date_mapping` fd\\nON om.fiscal_year = fd.fiscal_year\\nAND om.fiscal_year_week = fd.fiscal_year_week\\nAND om.fiscal_year_month = fd.fiscal_year_month\\nJOIN `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.season_master` sm\\nON fd.date BETWEEN sm.season_start_date AND sm.season_end_date\\nJOIN season_first_week sfw\\nON sm.season_code = sfw.season_code\\nWHERE om.s1_name = 'BnM'\\nGROUP BY\\nom.l0_name, om.l1_name, om.l2_name,\\nstore_type, sub_channel,\\nfd.fiscal_year, fd.fiscal_month, fd.fiscal_week,\\nsm.name, sm.season_code\\n)\\n\\nSELECT * FROM src_data\\n) AS src\\n\\n-- ====================================================================================\\n-- MATCH KEY (Ensures uniqueness)\\n-- ====================================================================================\\nON tgt.l0_name = src.l0_name\\nAND tgt.l1_name = src.l1_name\\nAND tgt.l2_name = src.l2_name\\nAND tgt.store_type = src.store_type\\nAND tgt.sub_channel = src.sub_channel\\nAND tgt.season_code = src.season_code\\nAND tgt.fiscal_year = src.fiscal_year\\nAND tgt.fiscal_month = src.fiscal_month\\nAND tgt.fiscal_week = src.fiscal_week\\n\\n-- ====================================================================================\\n-- UPDATE only if a KPI value actually changed\\n-- ====================================================================================\\nWHEN MATCHED AND (\\ntgt.ty_rcpt_units != src.ty_rcpt_units\\nOR tgt.ty_rcpt_cost != src.ty_rcpt_cost\\nOR tgt.ty_rcpt_msrp != src.ty_rcpt_msrp\\nOR tgt.rcpt_msrp != src.rcpt_msrp\\nOR tgt.target_revenue != src.target_revenue\\nOR tgt.target_cost != src.target_cost\\nOR tgt.target_units != src.target_units\\nOR tgt.bop_units != src.bop_units\\n)\\nTHEN UPDATE SET\\nty_rcpt_units = src.ty_rcpt_units,\\nty_rcpt_cost = src.ty_rcpt_cost,\\nty_rcpt_msrp = src.ty_rcpt_msrp,\\nrcpt_msrp = src.rcpt_msrp,\\ntarget_revenue = src.target_revenue,\\ntarget_cost = src.target_cost,\\ntarget_units = src.target_units,\\nbop_units = src.bop_units,\\nupdated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),\\nis_updated = TRUE\\n\\n-- ====================================================================================\\n-- MATCHED but unchanged — flag row as not updated\\n-- ====================================================================================\\nWHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET\\nis_updated = FALSE\\n\\n-- ====================================================================================\\n-- INSERT new rows\\n-- ====================================================================================\\nWHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (\\nl0_name, l1_name, l2_name,\\nstore_type, sub_channel,\\nfiscal_year, fiscal_month, fiscal_week,\\nseason_code, season_name,\\n\\nty_rcpt_units, ty_rcpt_cost, ty_rcpt_msrp,\\nrcpt_msrp, target_revenue, target_cost,\\ntarget_units, bop_units,\\n\\ncreated_at, updated_at, is_updated\\n)\\nVALUES (\\nsrc.l0_name, src.l1_name, src.l2_name,\\nsrc.store_type, src.sub_channel,\\nsrc.fiscal_year, src.fiscal_month, src.fiscal_week,\\nsrc.season_code, src.season_name,\\n\\nsrc.ty_rcpt_units, src.ty_rcpt_cost, src.ty_rcpt_msrp,\\nsrc.rcpt_msrp, src.target_revenue, src.target_cost,\\nsrc.target_units, src.bop_units,\\n\\nCURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), TRUE\\n);\\nSELECT \\n    l0_name,\\n    l1_name,\\n    l2_name,\\n    store_type,\\n    sub_channel,\\n    fiscal_year,\\n    fiscal_month,\\n    fiscal_week,\\n    season_code,\\n    ty_rcpt_units,\\n    ty_rcpt_cost,\\n    ty_rcpt_msrp,\\n    rcpt_msrp,\\n    target_revenue,\\n    target_cost,\\n    target_units,\\n    bop_units,\\n    created_at,\\n    updated_at,\\n    is_updated,\\n    season_name\\n FROM {project_id}.{dataset_id}.ty_receipts_new WHERE is_updated=True;"}
